# Promise versus instance

`customer_support.mm.sla_management.promise_versus_instance` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> Entitlement is the promise; an SLA target is that promise instantiated on one ticket. The first is a clause, the second is a timestamp.

Collapsing them is the most common modelling error in ticketing software. It makes it impossible to express a ticket whose clock is wrong because the entitlement lookup was wrong, which is one of the most common ways an SLA goes bad.
